lemma untop₀_coe (a : α) : (a : WithTop α).untop₀ = a := rfl

end Zero

## Simplifying Lemmas in cases where α is an AddMonoid

    (a + b).untop₀ = a.untop₀ + b.untop₀ := untopD_add ha hb

/-!
## Simplifying Lemmas in cases where α is a MulZeroClass
